name: Wageningen University & Research
summary: Life-sciences university in the small town of Wageningen; 8 English-taught BSc programmes in food, animals, environment, oceans, data and tourism.

ib.text: Full IB Diploma. Strictest: Maths AI HL or AA SL/HL plus Chemistry and Physics, one at HL (2026 list). IB taught only in English, English A at 5, or English B HL 6/SL 7 covers English.

apply.via: Studielink, then WUR's Osiris application portal

programmes.name: Animal Sciences
programmes.ib: Maths AI HL or AA SL/HL, Chemistry and Biology; one of these at HL (2026 list).
programmes.about: The biology of animals, from pets to livestock and fish, and how their health, behaviour and welfare connect with people, food production and the environment, including sustainable livestock farming.

needs.note: One of Maths, Chemistry and Biology must be HL.

programmes.selectionNote: No cap: meet the subject requirements and you are admitted. Apply early and send your marks so WUR can list any missing subjects. 2026 criteria; 2027 not yet published.

programmes.name: Data Science for Global Challenges
programmes.ib: Maths AI HL or AA SL/HL, plus Chemistry, Biology or Physics (2026 list). Choose the English track; a Dutch track runs alongside.
programmes.about: Data science and AI applied to climate change, health and food security, such as spotting deforestation in satellite images or tracking how diseases spread. Choose the English track.
programmes.selectionNote: No cap: meet the subject requirements and you are admitted. Apply early and send your marks so WUR can list any missing subjects. 2026 criteria; 2027 not yet published.

programmes.name: Earth System Sciences
programmes.ib: Maths AI HL or AA SL/HL, Chemistry and Physics, one of the two at HL (2026 list).
programmes.about: How soil, water and atmosphere interact, from groundwater flow to atmospheric turbulence, learned through fieldwork, lab work, simulations and data analysis, applied to floods, drought and climate. Formerly Soil, Water, Atmosphere.

needs.note: One of the named sciences must be HL.
One of the named sciences must be HL.

programmes.selectionNote: No cap: meet the subject requirements and you are admitted. Apply early and send your marks so WUR can list any missing subjects. 2026 criteria; 2027 not yet published.

programmes.name: Environmental Sciences
programmes.ib: Maths AI HL or AA SL/HL, Chemistry and Physics, one of the two at HL (2026 list).
programmes.about: The relationship between people and the environment studied through natural, social and technological sciences together, in international teams working on climate and sustainability problems.

needs.note: One of the named sciences must be HL.
One of the named sciences must be HL.

programmes.selectionNote: No cap: meet the subject requirements and you are admitted. Apply early and send your marks so WUR can list any missing subjects. 2026 criteria; 2027 not yet published.

programmes.name: Food Technology
programmes.ib: Maths AI HL or AA SL/HL, Chemistry, and Biology or Physics; one of the sciences at HL (2026 list).
programmes.about: The science of making food: ingredients, processing, packaging, safety and quality, applied straight away to real products, with room to deepen or broaden as you find your interests.

needs.note: One of the named sciences must be HL.
One of the named sciences must be HL.

programmes.selectionNote: No cap: meet the subject requirements and you are admitted. Apply early and send your marks so WUR can list any missing subjects. 2026 criteria; 2027 not yet published.

programmes.name: International Land and Water Management
programmes.ib: Maths AI HL or AA SL/HL, and Physics SL or HL (2026 list).
programmes.about: Drought, erosion and flooding tackled with natural science, social science and engineering, with cases from Peru to Thailand and a third-year internship and research project abroad.
programmes.selectionNote: No cap: meet the subject requirements and you are admitted. Apply early and send your marks so WUR can list any missing subjects. 2026 criteria; 2027 not yet published.

programmes.name: Marine Sciences
programmes.ib: Maths AI HL or AA SL/HL, Chemistry and Biology, one of the two at HL (2026 list).
programmes.about: The sea seen from nature, food and society: marine ecology alongside the ocean as a resource for the people who depend on it, working with engineers, biologists and policymakers.

needs.note: One of the named sciences must be HL.
One of the named sciences must be HL.

programmes.selectionNote: No cap: meet the subject requirements and you are admitted. Apply early and send your marks so WUR can list any missing subjects. 2026 criteria; 2027 not yet published.

programmes.name: Tourism (joint degree)
programmes.ib: Maths AI or AA, SL or HL (2026 list). Joint degree with Breda University of Applied Sciences; you apply to WUR in Studielink.
programmes.about: Tourism studied through social, economic and environmental science, asking how travel can become more sustainable; a joint degree of Wageningen University and Breda University of Applied Sciences.
programmes.selectionNote: No cap: meet the subject requirements and you are admitted. Apply early and send your marks so WUR can list any missing subjects. 2026 criteria; 2027 not yet published.

notes: WUR's 2027 deadlines are not yet published; for 2026 entry EU/EEA applicants applied in Studielink by 15 June (non-EU by 15 April).
Send a recent list of marks early: WUR assesses you on it and its result letter says which subject conditions you must still meet.
Its other twelve bachelor's, including Biology and Plant Sciences, are Dutch-taught and need proof of Dutch as well as English.
